proposal_authority: agent-prepared from implementation/ARCHITECTURE.md; not owner approval
binary_domain: All finite byte-aligned BEAM binaries; no length bound or validity precondition
wrapper_domain: Every nonbinary BEAM term, including nonbyte-aligned bitstrings
quantifier: For every input in each domain

policy.split: Split at byte 0x2F preserving every empty component; empty input splits to [<<>>]
policy.valid: Every component is nonempty, not exact 0x2E or 0x2E2E, and contains no 0x00
policy.valid_result: Exactly {:ok, split_slash(input)}, with identical component bytes and order
policy.totality: Returns the exact result without unexpected exception or exhaustion for every domain input, under idealized sufficient memory

expectation_semantics: The translated expectation must return Except.ok Lynx.Term.true, not equality between potentially exhausted computations
assumptions: Idealized sufficient memory for arbitrary finite inputs; no practical runtime or denial-of-service bound
BEAM compiler/runtime, debug-info Core reconstruction, Lynx translation and reached runtime models are trust dependencies, not validated by this policy review
A later formal result additionally trusts its stated Lean/checker/toolchain closure and permitted standard axioms
exclusions: Unicode decoding or normalization; invalid UTF-8 remains ordinary bytes
Percent decoding; backslash and colon have no special interpretation
Filesystem, symlink, Windows path, ZIP archive or safe extraction semantics
Process, ETS, network, ports, native effects and deployment/resource guarantees
approval_rule: Only explicit owner acceptance of this candidate SHA256 creates an accepted record; no test, law, proof or agent proposal can approve it
reapproval_rule: Changes to policy bytes, domains, quantifiers, required predicates, outputs, assumptions or exclusions need a new candidate and explicit approval. Implementation/proof-only changes need fresh artifact binding, exact unchanged-predicate review and rechecking; they cannot weaken this contract. Initial law-source hashes identify these prepared bytes, not future proof artifacts.
proof_status: No universal proof, exported closure, conformance guarantee or product receipt; Lean identities above are required expected names pending generated-statement inspection in phase 03
